_comment: Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json. context-monitor and agent-starter add their own hooks on install; this adds the lint gate on agent-config edits.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *CLAUDE.md|*AGENTS.md|*SKILL.md|*.mcp.json|*settings.json) skillsaw lint "$f" 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; esac
